items.text: Run only affected tests while working; the full suite once at the end.
items.evidence: Tests took 39% of agent time (43 min 59 s of 1 h 54 min); "tsc" ran 9 times
items.rule: Rule: tests and checks at 35% of agent time or more (setting hintTestsPct).

items.text: Put these files in the brief so each agent skips re-reading them.
items.evidence: 4 files read by 3+ agents each: grid-plan.mjs, board-logic.mjs, kind-meta.mjs, ...
items.rule: Rule: 3+ files read by 3+ agents each (settings hintSharedFiles, hintSharedAgents).

items.text: Read why a command failed before re-running it; put known fixes in the brief.
items.evidence: Re-ran straight after failing 4 times; most often "tsc" (3)
items.rule: Rule: 3+ immediate re-runs after a failure (setting hintRetries).
